summary: Master e-commerce operations and digital merchandising with GA4, PIM, and conversion-focused workflows. Build dashboards and action plans.
lede: Digital merchandising operations training helps online commerce professionals align product content, inventory, and traffic with trading goals. Learners practice tracking GA4 commerce metrics, diagnosing catalog and feed quality, and improving category and product pages using principles such as AIDA. They also develop inventory-aware workflows and reporting packs to communicate performance and support day-to-day trading decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in online commerce operations and need sharper control over merchandising, analytics, and execution.
modules: Digital Commerce Foundations and Merchandising Role
Category Pages and Product Page Merchandising
prerequisites: Before attending, you should bring a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and sample ecommerce reports, product feeds, or dashboard screenshots from your own work context if available. Familiarity with GA4, Google Merchant Center, PIM exports, or marketplace seller dashboards will help you apply the exercises faster, but the course also provides structured templates and guided practice for participants who use different platforms.
